key.name: primary-limit
key.description: The pop-up always lists every limit; this is the one figure on the button itself. "highest": whichever limit is closest to being used up, which is the one that will stop you first. "session": the current session only. "weekly": the week's own limit, ignoring the per-model ones.

key.name: show-percent
key.summary: Show the percentage beside the icon
key.description: With this off the button is the icon alone, tinted by how much has been used, and the figures are in the pop-up.

key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Which end of the top bar the button sits at
key.description: "right" puts it among the status icons, "center" beside the clock, "left" beside Activities.

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position within that end of the top bar
key.description: 0 is the end nearest the middle of the bar; -1 puts the button last. Which neighbours it lands between depends on what other extensions have put there.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often to ask the provider for the figures. Opening the pop-up always reads them again, and so does the stored login changing, so a long interval here still gives you fresh numbers when you look.

key.name: poll-when-idle
key.summary: Keep reading while the screen is locked or idle
key.description: Off by default: a locked screen has nobody looking at the button, so the readings are skipped until it is unlocked.

key.name: warn-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which a limit counts as nearly used up

key.name: critical-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which a limit counts as almost gone

key.name: notify-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which to send a notification
key.description: 0 turns notifications off. Above 0, crossing that percentage notifies once per limit, and not again until that limit resets.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Turning a provider off stops it being read at all, and removes it from the pop-up. A provider whose command-line tool is not installed is left out whatever this says.

key.name: show-in-panel
key.summary: Let this provider's figure appear on the button
key.description: With this off the provider is still listed in the pop-up, but never supplies the single figure on the button itself. Useful when one subscription is the one you actually watch.

key.name: show-per-model
key.description: Some providers meter each model separately as well as the account as a whole. With this off only the whole-account limits are listed.

key.name: show-breakdown
key.description: A line naming which of the provider's surfaces the period's usage came from, when the provider reports it.

key.name: show-credits
key.description: Usage bought beyond the plan's limits, when the provider reports it and you have it turned on with them.
